0022600126.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (3-0, on a three-game winning streak) come into this 4th game of the season 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, with a 2-0 road record. The Utah Jazz (1-2, on a one-game losing streak) are 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and 11th in the West, with a 1-1 home record. Memphis is missing Karim Lopez and Zach Edey, who are both day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic and Trey Alexander, who are both out. The Grizzlies lead this season's series 1-0 after a 123-103 win in Memphis on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
